fields.standard: stable data-testid names: input-first_name, input-last_name, input-email, input-current_company, input-phone_number, input-linkedin_link, input-website_link; files input-resume and input-cover_letter (hidden inputs behind 'Drop or select (.doc / .docx / .pdf)')

custom_questions.widget: div role=combobox aria-autocomplete=list aria-haspopup=listbox aria-required=true, id=field-NN, whose ONLY name is aria-label='Select'
custom_questions.question_text:
a

about 7 levels up, not linked by label/for or aria-labelledby -- pair each box with the nearest question text above it
custom_questions.gotcha: read by accessible name alone, every custom question is 'Select'

fields.location: input with aria-autocomplete=list (a places search) and a hidden input-externalPlaceId filled by picking a suggestion
fields.phone_code: input role=combobox placeholder 'Search' (country code) beside the phone number
fields.choice_search: input role=combobox placeholder 'Search'/'Select...' (pronouns, race) -- searchable single select
fields.eeo: div role=combobox labelled Gender, Are you Hispanic/Latino?, Veteran Status
fields.consent: radiogroup sms_opt_in with hidden styled radios ('Yes - I consent to receiving text messages' / 'No ...') -- the owner's decision
